summary: Perspective Therapeutics filed a routine Form 8-K under Items 8.01 and 9.01 to furnish an updated corporate presentation as Exhibit 99.1, signed by CFO Joel Sendek on October 1, 2026. The deck reviews next-generation radiopharmaceutical assets VMT-α-NET, VMT01, PSV359 and PSV594 across a claimed $45 billion-plus solid tumor market, citing 2026 data readouts. No transaction, stake, price, premium, board recommendation, advisor, financing, tender or structural mechanic is disclosed. Not a special situation; no deal terms. Watch only for pipeline data catalysts, financing needs and registration-path updates rather than any risk-arb event.
